description: System health auditing capability handling database optimization, vector store integrity checks, resource guarding, telemetry gathering, and automated skill gap resolution.
author: Charon Librarian

optimize_databases.description: Runs SQLite PRAGMA and VACUUM optimizations on target databases.

target_db.description: Optional explicit path or directory to target for database optimization.

audit_vector_store.description: Audits Chroma vector store directory, collection structures, and SQLite integrity.

get_system_health.description: Gathers host telemetry, CPU/RAM utilization, and system database file sizes.

audit_resource_guard.description: Audits process memory, disk utilization, GPU usage, and verifies system limits for LLM execution.

resolve_skill_gaps.description: Sweeps for open skill gaps, notifies the IPC daemon, and triggers charon-forge automated scaffolding.
